storeInfo.name: Turnpike Cafe
storeInfo.tagline: Classic American Grill & Comfort Food in Norwich | Clásica Comida Americana

policies.restroomLocationEs: Ubicado hacia la parte trasera del salón principal.
policies.restroomLocationEn: Located towards the back of the main dining room.
policies.restroomCodeEn: Open for dining guests (no code required).
policies.parkingPolicyEs: Estacionamiento disponible en el lote contiguo o en la calle.
policies.parkingPolicyEn: Parking available in adjacent lot or street parking.
policies.returnPolicyEs: Nos esforzamos por la satisfacción total; por favor notifique a su mesero de inmediato.
policies.returnPolicyEn: We strive for complete guest satisfaction; please notify your server immediately.
policies.deliveryPolicyEs: Servicio para llevar disponible por teléfono y plataformas de entrega locales.
policies.deliveryPolicyEn: Takeout service available by phone and local delivery platforms.

products.descriptionEs: Alitas crujientes bañadas en nuestra salsa picante casera, servidas con bastones de apio y aderezo de queso azul.
products.descriptionEn: Crispy wings tossed in our signature house buffalo sauce, served with celery sticks and chunky blue cheese dressing.

products.descriptionEs: Pieles de papa horneadas crujientes, repletas de queso cheddar derretido, tocino crujiente y cebollino fresco, con crema agria.
products.descriptionEn: Crispy baked potato skins loaded with melted cheddar cheese, crispy bacon bits, and fresh chives, served with sour cream.

products.descriptionEs: Calamares tiernos empanizados y fritos a la perfección, servidos con rodajas de limón y nuestra salsa marinara casera.
products.descriptionEn: Tender calamari lightly breaded and fried to golden perfection, served with lemon wedges and house-made marinara sauce.
Juicy grilled Angus beef patty topped with crisp lettuce, tomato, red onion, and cheddar cheese on a toasted brioche bun. Served with fries.
Crispy breaded chicken breast topped with smoked bacon, crisp lettuce, and creamy ranch dressing on an artisan roll.
Grilled zucchini, bell peppers, onions, and mushrooms tossed with fresh spinach and a touch of garlic aioli in a whole wheat tortilla.

products.nameEs: Bistec NY Strip a la Parrilla
products.descriptionEn: 12 oz New York Strip steak cooked to perfection, served with garlic mashed potatoes and fresh seasonal vegetables.

products.nameEs: Pechuga de Pollo a la Parmesana
products.descriptionEn: Breaded chicken breast topped with marinara sauce and melted mozzarella cheese, served over a bed of steaming linguine pasta.
Fresh Atlantic salmon filet brushed with a sweet honey-mustard glaze, served with rice pilaf and sautéed asparagus.
Refreshing house-made natural lemonade infused with a sweet puree of fresh raspberries.
Draft IPA brewed locally in Connecticut breweries featuring bright citrus and floral hop notes.
Freshly brewed black tea, lightly sweetened and served over plenty of ice with a fresh lemon wheel.

faqs.qEn: Do you offer vegetarian or gluten-free options?
faqs.aEs: Sí, pregunte a nuestro personal por las opciones marcadas en el menú o adaptadas para alergias.
faqs.aEn: Yes, please ask our staff for menu items that can be prepared vegetarian or gluten-free.

faqs.aEs: Aceptamos clientes sin reservación y reservaciones por teléfono para grupos o fines de semana.
faqs.aEn: We welcome walk-ins and phone reservations for parties or weekend dining.
